title: Church, religion and hymns
summary: Asked whether Bolden's family went to church, Jones cannot answer; he says he was raised Baptist but does not sing and recalls no hymns. The transcript has garbled repetition here.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
